chapter: Dream band, reading and closing thoughts
title: Roy Haynes on drums and recapping the dream band
summary: Roy Haynes is her only drummer choice; Williams recaps the band of Haynes, Mraz, Hargrove, Rollins and Woods with her on piano.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players
